scope: Only new admission helpers, fixed literal event/PR/CI dictionaries and GO bytes, finite fault mutations, static workflow/source inspection, and temporary local auth input/output files. finite_cases.case: A valid owner-authored first PR-body admission on the exact branch/base returns exact newline-terminated GO bytes and reconciled provenance.
Unauthorized event sender, event PR author, live PR author or repository owner fails closed, including fixed identity-ID disagreement.
Stale event head, stale live body, changed base, wrong repository, wrong PR number or noncanonical PR/API URL fails closed.
Missing body change, unchanged body, prior admission marker or prior digest marker, non-edited action, closed/merged PR or branch drift blocks first admission.
No marker, incomplete/repeated markers, multiple digest lines, malformed digest, digest mismatch, empty/oversized payload or body, duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite JSON fail closed.
Wrong preregistration Issue URL, admission PR URL, GO head/tree shape, repository, branch, schema or admitted flag fails closed.
Wrong authenticated CI run ID, repository, head, branch, event, workflow path, URL, status or conclusion fails closed.

Compile only the new admission module at optimize=2 and call its pure authentication function on literal invalid sender and invalid digest stubs; both still reject. Static source check finds no authentication assert statements.

CLI authenticates bounded literal input files to exclusive durable output files with raw-input digests and rejects output reuse, symlink inputs and unexpected Python environment/optimization flags before authentication. The CLI case mocks only fixed interpreter flags and environment for a portable literal-file test; pure retained-provenance verification re-reads every actual test file without authentication mocks. Mutate retained input bytes and fixed request-context workflow-run/attempt, checkout and attempt-path fields; all must reject. Original runner locations are checked lexically after copying, not accessed by the offline helper.

Static workflow inspection proves edited-only trigger, exact repository/base/branch/owner/run-attempt gate, durable shell-initialized paths outside temp/checkout, sanitation before every Python auth/measure/preserve execution, authenticated fresh API fetch, no dispatch-only path, retained inputs/partial output and one failure-preserving 600-second preservation invocation.
